nodes.title: Round 7 F follow-up (not built): App's growth page (growth.ts) could use a per-skill 'first try' stamp: the date and outcome of a child's first unaided attempt on each skill, so growth reads from a true start. Learning would derive it from kt_evidence (first C0/other per skill). Build when App asks for it. Reverse if: growth.ts finds an equivalent from existing evidence rows.

Round 7 F: the c8 maths scope fixes (Sierpinski carpet and Koch snowflake for the Cantor set; the rectangle converse as 'equal diagonals that bisect each other') were checked against study-site quotes of the NCERT chapters, because ncert.nic.in returned 503. Each affected kit entry says so in its `source` field. Reverse if: a re-read of the NCERT PDFs (hegp104, the fractals chapter of part 2) differs; then re-scope those entries.

md.decisions:
## `o-r7-skill-first-try-stamp` (2026-11-08, F Learning; follow-up)
Main relayed an App wish: the growth page (growth.ts) would like a stamp per skill of the child's first unaided try, with its date and outcome, so a growth line starts from a true baseline. Learning can derive it from kt_evidence, the first C0 or other outcome per skill, without a new write path. This is logged here and not built.

**Reverse if:** growth.ts finds an equivalent in existing evidence rows.

## `dc-r7-c8-scope-sources-secondary` (2026-11-08, F Learning)
The pilot scope fixes were checked against secondary sources, because NCERT's site was down. Six kit entries carry a `source` field that says so and asks for a re-check against the NCERT PDFs. Main said not to block on it.

**Reverse if:** the NCERT text differs.
